title: Ioash
summary: Raleigh names Ioash in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ioash, of the issue of Iuda, named with Iokim and Sareph in Moab. He is not Ioas king of Israel, and not Joash of Judah. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. IV, subsection V, sig. 246b
